items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: Louis Dumaine. And the set up when he used to work at the Broom place there.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. You know it might seem odd, but at that time, for like, what's his name? Cuckoo. Cuckoo. You know I used to like to hear Cuckoo play. And then now the Cuckoo is- Well Cuckoo was a pretty good trumpet. Yeah, he was a pretty good trumpet at that time. And what was his set up for there? Louis Dumaine. And the set up when he used to work at the Broom place there. Maurice Duran. Maurice Duran. Yeah, I was proud of him.
He used to play in the alley right by the Seminole Market on the side that was the alley. And quite nice to know. The cab right there, he called it the alley.
